title: 07 — QUALITY STANDARDS & CODING STANDARDS
summary: Measurable quality thresholds per deliverable class plus binding coding standards for naming, imports, config, logging, and error handling.
notes: No frontmatter and no adr/spec path convention. Content is a table of non-functional requirements with named enforcement points plus binding implementation contracts -> SPEC over DOC. Mentions ADR requirement for new dependencies but records no decision itself.
